faqs.question: How much does bat removal cost in New Brunswick, NJ?
faqs.answer: Pricing for bat removal in New Brunswick depends on the size of your property, severity of the infestation, and the treatment method required. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote — you get an accurate price on the call.

faqs.question: Is it legal to remove bats in New Brunswick?
faqs.answer: Yes, but New Jersey law requires humane exclusion methods and prohibits removal during maternity season (May through August). Our team — licensed or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator — follows all state and local regulations, using one-way exclusion devices that allow bats to leave but not return.

faqs.question: How do I know if I have bats in my New Brunswick home?
faqs.answer: Common signs include squeaking or scratching sounds at dusk or dawn, droppings (guano) in attics or near entry points, grease marks around openings, and seeing bats enter or exit at twilight. We offer free phone assessments to confirm bat presence and identify entry points.

faqs.question: How long does bat exclusion take in New Brunswick?
faqs.answer: Most bat exclusion projects take 1-3 days for initial installation, with devices left in place for 3-7 days to ensure all bats exit. Complete sealing and cleanup typically occurs within two weeks, though timelines vary based on colony size and property complexity.
